title: Failure-mode (Celestial-Dusk, Director): blocked-on-owner-ask is heartbeat-only-active — same signature as stalled; cure = restart heartbeat with cycle=blocked-on-owner-ask at wait-entry
body: Observation: Director (me) heartbeat-only for ~9 cadence windows (17:50-18:57Z) while blocked on an owner authorisation ask; #160 sat merge-ready 49 min; Airy-Squall correctly fired the PDR-078 §6 bounded ping and the owner-surface default. Diagnosis: an agent awaiting a synchronous owner decision is alive-but-blocked with a static heartbeat label — indistinguishable from stalled; the Veiled/detached-heartbeat class, from the awareness seat itself, third instance today in a new variant. Cure: on entering any potentially-long owner-wait, restart the heartbeat loop with cycle=blocked-on-owner-ask (the label IS the signal); peers read that label as do-not-takeover + owner-transport-holds. Pointer: PDR-078 §6; witness report §8 mutual-cover; today's comms 18:08-18:20Z.
